headline: We'll rebuild your website for free — see it before you pay a cent
subhead: Paste your URL. In 48 hours you get a studio-quality homepage redesign built from your own photos and real business info — free to look at, no card required.
trustLine: Built from your real photos and Google listing — never generic stock.

steps.title: Paste your URL
steps.body: Tell us what's not working about your current site.

steps.title: We build it
steps.body: 48 hours later, a full homepage redesign is live for you to see.

steps.title: You decide
steps.body: Free to look at. Go live on your own domain only if you want to.

faq.question: Is this actually free?
faq.answer: Yes — the homepage redesign is free to see, no card required. Going live on your own domain is a one-time build fee plus hosting.

faq.question: Will it use my real photos?
faq.answer: We pull from your existing site and Google Business Profile first. We only add a stock photo if a section would otherwise be empty.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: 48 hours from when you submit your URL.

faq.question: What if I don't like it?
faq.answer: No obligation — it's yours to look at either way. You only pay if you want to go live with it.

faq.question: Do I need my own Facebook Business account?
faq.answer: Yes — ads run through your own Facebook Business Manager and ad account. That means you own the pixel and the audience data, not us.

faq.question: Is the $25/day ad spend included in the $290?
faq.answer: No. The $290 covers our setup and campaign management. Ad spend goes straight from you to Facebook, in your own account, so it's never a black box.

faq.question: What happens after the 30-day pilot?
faq.answer: You continue at $97/month plus $10 per lead we process. No contract — cancel anytime, no cancellation fee.

faq.question: Do I own the website and the ad creatives?
faq.answer: Yes. The landing page, the ad creatives, and every lead we generate are yours to keep, even if you decide not to continue after the pilot.

faq.question: What if I already have a website?
faq.answer: We build the redesign alongside your existing site — nothing changes for your current visitors until you decide to go live with the new one.

faq.question: Is there a long-term contract?
faq.answer: No. After the 30-day pilot it's month-to-month — cancel whenever you want, no long-term commitment.

faq.question: What actually counts as a lead?
faq.answer: Real contact info — name, phone, or email — submitted through the campaign we build for you. Not a click, a like, or a page view.

faq.question: Do you offer support once it's live?
faq.answer: Yes — the same real people you talk to during setup, not a support ticket queue. See who you'd actually be working with above.

faq.question: How is this different from buying leads on a marketplace?
faq.answer: Every lead we generate is exclusive to you. Marketplace platforms typically sell the same lead to several competing businesses at once — ours never are.

faq.question: Is my business information kept private?
faq.answer: Yes. We only use your real business info and photos to build your redesign and campaign — nothing is sold or shared with third parties.

faq.question: What trades do you work with?
faq.answer: Contractors, electricians, HVAC, plumbers, roofers, remodelers, homebuilders, movers, pest control, and restoration companies — real home-service trades, not a one-size-fits-all template.
